tasks.label: Compose: up + post-startup
tasks.detail: Create the KinD cluster if missing (or start its node containers if stopped), podman compose up -d for docker-compose.yaml, generate the Jenkins secrets (jenkins/secrets/) and Vault credential placeholders (vault-tf/jenkins-credentials/) before compose, run each service's post-startup actions (e.g. Nexus admin password, wait for Jenkins and its agent, init/unseal Vault), then terraform apply every *-tf module (restarting jenkins afterwards if vault-tf wrote a new AppRole credential)

tasks.label: Compose: first-time setup (set Nexus admin password)
tasks.detail: Same as Compose: up + post-startup, but first asks for the Nexus admin password and changes admin from its initial password to it. Only needed while nexus-tf/terraform.auto.tfvars.json does not exist; afterwards the password is read from that file and the plain task never prompts

tasks.label: Terraform: apply all
tasks.detail: terraform init + apply for every *-tf module (nexus-tf, vault-tf, ...) in its container, to keep the systems' internal resources up to date. Services must already be running (see Compose: up + post-startup, which runs this as its last step)

tasks.label: Helm: test chart(s)
tasks.detail: Pick a chart (or all, in sequence) and run helm lint + helm-unittest + kubeconform on it in the helm-cicd container

tasks.label: Helm: publish chart to Nexus
tasks.detail: Pick a chart and a semver version, set that version in the chart's Chart.yaml, run the full tests on it, then package it and push it to oci://localhost:8081/oci-internal/helm/deployment-templates (plain HTTP) as helm-publisher, in the helm-cicd container

inputs.description: Semantic version to publish (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, e.g. 1.2.0 or 1.3.0-rc.1)
